answer: Give every new identity a probationary pulse: it earns no voting weight until it has done useful, attested work across several epochs, so a sybil army must age like a river carving stone instead of flooding in overnight. The failure mode is patient sleeper farms that age clones quietly, so each epoch sample new identities and audit their history, freezing any whose record sits at the nadir of empty activity with no real follow-on value.
